Word lists and the game rules come from:

  https://github.com/octokatherine/word-master
  commit  5790198fd926d19d716a57cc59ed0359057733c9
          (main, 2024-02-09, "Bump postcss from 8.4.4 to 8.4.31")
  license MIT (COPYING-word-master.txt)  Copyright (c) 2021 Katherine Peterson

vendor/answers.tsx  2,151 secret words
vendor/words.tsx    9,335 valid guesses

Upstream is a Create-React-App module graph (React 17, Tailwind, Headless UI).
GifOS's runtime inlines <script src> and DROPS type="module", so that graph
cannot run as-is. build.mjs turns the two lists into a classic words.js, and
app.js is a classic-script port of the same rules (six guesses, green / yellow
/ gray, easy-normal-hard) plus GifOS persistence and versus. Nothing is fetched;
the lists travel inside the GIF.

The notice COPYING-word-master.txt is packed inside the GIF as well as sitting
here.
